title: SCE 2.5 Preventive Probe: IMDS Weakening Prevention (Revised)
description: Security Chaos Engineering experiment validating preventive controls (IAM Deny policies) against EC2 IMDS weakening attacks. This revised implementation uses simplified IAM-only testing to improve reliability. It verifies that unauthorized principals cannot enumerate EC2 instances or modify IMDS configurations, blocking attack steps 1.1 and 2.1 at the IAM policy boundary.

steady-state-hypothesis.title: IAM Deny Policies Block IMDS Weakening Attempts
steady-state-hypothesis.description: System hypothesis: IAM policies with explicit Deny statements prevent any unauthorized principal from enumerating EC2 instances (DescribeInstances) or modifying instance metadata options (ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions). Attack steps 1.1 and 2.1 fail at the IAM boundary with AccessDenied errors before any state modification occurs.

method.name: deploy-iam-infrastructure
method.description: Deploy CloudFormation stack with restricted IAM role (explicit Deny on DescribeInstances and ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions), control role for baseline, and configuration for assume-role testing

method.name: execute-attack-steps
method.description: Simulate attacker actions: assume restricted role, attempt DescribeInstances (step 1.1), attempt ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions (step 2.1). Verify all calls are blocked with AccessDenied.

rollbacks.name: cleanup-experiment-resources
rollbacks.description: Delete CloudFormation stack and all associated IAM roles and policies. Ensure complete resource cleanup regardless of test outcome.

context.threat_model: Nation-state and organized cybercriminal APT groups targeting financial infrastructure
context.attack_goal: Exfiltrate temporary AWS credentials via weakened EC2 IMDS configuration to enable lateral movement and data access

attack_chain.ttp: T1526 - Gather System Network Configuration Discovery
T1552.001 - Unsecured Credentials in Cloud Instance Metadata

stride_goals: Elevation of Privilege (assume EC2 IAM role)

mechanisms: IAM policy with explicit Deny on ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions
IAM policy with explicit Deny on DescribeInstances
safeguard_focus.expected_outcome: All attack API calls blocked at IAM boundary with AccessDenied error; no state modification occurs

probe_details.probe_intent: Validate that IAM Deny policies prevent unauthorized principals from enumerating EC2 instances or weakening IMDS configurations

attack_nodes.expected_preventive_behavior: Access Denied error (AccessDenied or UnauthorizedOperation); enumeration blocked at IAM boundary
Access Denied error (AccessDenied or UnauthorizedOperation); IMDS config modification blocked at IAM boundary

Query error code from restricted role API call; verify contains 'AccessDenied' or 'UnauthorizedOperation'
verification_checklist.pass_criteria: Error code matches AccessDenied pattern or InvalidInstanceID (because no instance exists, but IAM boundary still enforced)

verification_checklist.description: IAM Deny policies remain in place
verification_checklist.validation_method: Query IAM role policies; verify DenyIMDSModification policy contains Deny statements for DescribeInstances and ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions
verification_checklist.pass_criteria: Both Deny statements present and unchanged

success_criteria.overall_pass_condition: All required checks (P2.5.1, P2.5.2) must pass; optional check (P2.5.3) passes if IAM policies can be verified
fail_on: Error codes do not indicate access denial (AccessDenied or UnauthorizedOperation)
Attack results data structure is missing or incomplete

consequences: Lateral movement to other AWS resources
Access to banking microservices and databases

impact_with_preventive_controls.consequence: Attack blocked at IAM boundary; no state change; no credentials exfiltrated; no impact

blast_radius_mitigation: Experiment runs in isolated AWS account with no production resources
CloudFormation stack creates only test IAM roles (no compute resources)
All resources tagged and timestamped for easy cleanup

improvements_from_previous_execution.fix_1: Simplified template: removed EC2 instance, CloudTrail, S3 bucket. Now only IAM resources (faster, more reliable)
improvements_from_previous_execution.issue_2: RoleArn parameter was None, causing attack phase failure
improvements_from_previous_execution.fix_2: Better parameter extraction and validation; explicit error logging; fallback checks
improvements_from_previous_execution.issue_3: No attack results data for probe verification
improvements_from_previous_execution.fix_3: Comprehensive error handling in attack() function; attack_results stored to EXPERIMENT_STATE before verification
improvements_from_previous_execution.issue_4: Limited diagnostics when stack creation fails
improvements_from_previous_execution.fix_4: Added CloudFormation event logging; detailed status messages at each stage
improvements_from_previous_execution.issue_5: IAM propagation delays causing role not found errors
improvements_from_previous_execution.fix_5: Increased IAM propagation wait from 30s to 60s with better logging
improvements_from_previous_execution.issue_6: No handling for hypothetical instance IDs in attack simulation
improvements_from_previous_execution.fix_6: ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions accepts invalid instance IDs; IAM Deny still enforced at policy level

Attack: DescribeInstances and ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions calls blocked with AccessDenied
